I give talks and workshops about systems I have built: agent evaluation, production RAG, LLM application design, and MLOps. Courses are listed on the [Work page](work.qmd#courses).

## Selected talks and workshops

::: {.talk}
<div class="item-meta">2025<br>W&B webinar</div>

:::

::: {.talk}

:::

## Community

I was a **Google Developer Expert in Machine Learning** from 2022 to 2025. I have also taught through GDG communities, Kaggle, W&B events, and local ML groups.

For a session, workshop, or collaboration, the best way to reach me is [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ayush-thakur-731914149/).
